metadata.description: Sample escalated cases for testing the escalation system

escalated_cases.reason: Post-surgery follow-up severely overdue. Patient has not responded to 3 SMS reminders and 2 phone calls. Requires immediate clinical assessment for potential infection complications.

2026-08-05: SMS reminder sent - "Follow-up reminder: Please schedule your post-surgery checkup."
2026-08-10: Phone call attempted - No answer
2026-08-15: SMS reminder sent - "Urgent: Your post-surgery follow-up is now 14 days overdue."
2026-08-20: Phone call attempted - No answer
2026-09-15: CASE ESCALATED - Multiple failed contact attempts for critical post-surgery follow-up

escalated_cases.reason: Patient sent a complex clinical question via WhatsApp about persistent pain after root canal treatment. Question requires clinical expertise to answer. Agent determined this is beyond autonomous scope.
conversation_log: 2026-08-20: WhatsApp message sent - "Hi James, your root canal follow-up is due."
2026-08-22: Patient replied: "I still have pain on the left side. Is this normal 3 weeks after? The pain comes in waves and sometimes radiates to my ear. Should I stop taking the antibiotics?"
2026-08-22: Agent detected clinical question requiring expertise - escalated

escalated_cases.reason: Patient expressed frustration and confusion during SMS conversation. Multiple unclear responses detected. Patient appears to need clarification about treatment plan in a language-sensitive manner. Agent recommended human staff for personalized communication.
conversation_log: 2026-09-01: SMS sent - "Hi Siti, your orthodontic check-up is due."
2026-09-02: Patient replied: "I dont understand. When is it? I have meeting."
2026-09-03: SMS sent - "Please let us know your available dates for your check-up."
2026-09-04: Patient replied: "Ah? What meeting? I dont have meeting."
2026-09-05: SMS sent - "We would like to schedule your orthodontic check-up appointment."
2026-09-05: Patient replied: "Okay fine but I am busy. Call me later."
2026-09-19: CASE ESCALATED - Multiple unclear responses, patient appears frustrated

escalated_cases.reason: Periodontal treatment follow-up overdue. Patient requested to reschedule via SMS but provided conflicting dates. Agent could not reliably book an appointment autonomously. Requires staff assistance for date coordination.
conversation_log: 2026-08-18: SMS sent - "Hi 林秀英, your periodontal maintenance is due."
2026-08-19: Patient replied: "Can I come next Monday?"
2026-08-19: SMS sent - "Checking availability for next Monday. Would morning or afternoon work?"
2026-08-20: Patient replied: "Not Monday. Wednesday is good."
2026-08-20: SMS sent - "Checking Wednesday availability. Morning at 10am or afternoon at 2pm?"
2026-08-21: Patient replied: "Tomorrow is ok."
2026-08-22: SMS sent - "Clarifying: which date would you prefer for your appointment?"
2026-08-25: Patient replied: "Ah I forgot. Maybe next week?"
2026-09-20: CASE ESCALATED - Conflicting scheduling responses, unable to book autonomously

escalated_cases.reason: Emergency follow-up case. Patient reported severe toothache via WhatsApp and requested immediate appointment. Agent could not autonomously schedule emergency slot. Requires staff coordination for same-day emergency care.
conversation_log: 2026-09-15: Patient sent WhatsApp: "HELP! My tooth is killing me! I cant sleep! Is there any emergency appointment today???"
2026-09-15: Agent detected emergency intent and severe distress
2026-09-15: Patient sent: "Please help! The pain is getting worse!"
2026-09-21: CASE ESCALATED - Emergency case with severe patient distress, requires immediate human intervention

escalated_cases.reason: Pediatric follow-up case. Parent contacted via email asking about child braces adjustment and insurance coverage. Email thread contains complex clinical and billing questions. Requires staff with pediatric and billing expertise.
conversation_log: 2026-09-01: Email sent - "Hi Maria, your child Lucas has a overdue pediatric check-up."

2026-09-03: Parent replied: "Hi, Lucas has been complaining about his braces being tight. Also, can you tell me if our insurance covers the braces adjustment? We need to know before we come in. What documents do we need?"
2026-09-17: CASE ESCALATED - Complex clinical and billing inquiry for pediatric patient
